05/ 06.11.2025

The petitioner is seeking regular bail, in connection with CID P.S. Case No. 42 of 2024, registered for the offence under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 470,
471, 120-B and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 13(1)(d) read with Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, pending in the court of learned A.J.C.-XVIII- cum-Special Judge, CID, Ranchi.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is not named in the FIR and only allegations are made against the petitioner that he was involved in the conspiracy for embezzlement of certain amount.

He next submits that the other co- accused person already been allowed regular bail in B.A. Nos. 460 of 2025, 3368 of 2025 and 5793 of 2025 respectively in different CID cases by the co-ordinate benches.

He then submits that the other co- accused persons have also been allowed regular bail in B.A. Nos. 6837 of 2025 and 7123 of 2025 by this court in Sameer Kumar @ Samir Kumar @ Rudra Pratap vs The State Of Jharkhand on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43097338/
1 different cases.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He submits that the petitioner is in custody since 12.09.2025.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the [2025:JHHC:33255] prayer and submits that the petitioner was one of the conspirators.

4. Considering that the petitioner is not named in the FIR and he is in custody since 12.09.2025 and for different transactions, the four co-accused persons have already been allowed regular bail in the aforementioned B.As.
in different cases, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on regular bail.

5. Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on regular bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned A.J.C.-XVIII-cum-Special Judge, CID, Ranchi, in connection with CID P.S. Case No. 42 of 2024.

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Dated:-06.11.2025 Amitesh/-
